purpose: Public research starting points, NOT source approval, automatic crawl allowlist or photo permission.

sources.name: AGRI-TRAC2 OECD performance abstracts
sources.scope: Model and approval-number discovery; manufacturer-consented Code 2 abstracts only; verify exact transmission, approval number and test conditions.

sources.name: AGRI-TRAC2 2026 approvals
sources.scope: Prioritize 2026 approvals and all paginated entries; list entries are identities, not complete measured facts.

sources.name: OECD tractor codes
sources.scope: Separate Code 2 performance from protective structures and noise; do not infer measurements from standards.

sources.name: AGRI-TRAC2 testing stations
sources.scope: Discover national testing bodies; a station listing is not an individual test report.

sources.name: CFMTTI Budni test report summaries
sources.scope: Annual lists of commercial/initial/batch tests. Use original exact report and variant; report date is not model year.

sources.name: CFMTTI tested machines
sources.scope: Discover tested models, then resolve report and OEM source.

sources.name: Nebraska Tractor Test Lab
sources.scope: Public reports where available; do not purchase reports without authorization.

sources.name: UNL DigitalCommons tractor lab
sources.scope: Historic and modern test publications; use exact report ID and generation.

sources.name: Nebraska government documents
sources.scope: Annual historic summaries; preserve year, tested equipment and source.

sources.name: DLG report database
sources.scope: Measured report data only for matched configuration.

sources.name: DLG PowerMix
sources.scope: Keep workload, transport and field cycles distinct; do not convert g/kWh into L/h without valid assumptions.

sources.name: TAMTEST
sources.scope: Official testing and approval context; report access not guaranteed.

sources.name: NARO safety inspection results
sources.scope: Japanese model/market identity and explicitly listed safety equipment; no inferred performance or model year.

sources.name: NARO test methods
sources.scope: Distinguish safety inspection, ROPS and automation from performance tests.

sources.name: KoAT agricultural machinery
sources.scope: Official Korean machinery testing program; retrieve individual public reports separately.

sources.name: KoAT 2025 testing annual report announcement
sources.scope: Discover report publication; announcement is not a model technical table.

sources.name: Josephinum tractor reports
sources.scope: Use accessible actual reports and test codes.

sources.name: Estacion Mecanica Agricola
sources.scope: Official Spanish test station; obtain specific reports before using numeric data.

sources.name: Chinese Ministry of Agriculture machinery appraisal
sources.scope: Official test standard announcement; discover current model-specific approvals separately.

sources.name: INRAE Agate
sources.scope: Historical test documentation; check access, date, identity and reuse.

sources.name: UFSM Agrotecnologia
sources.scope: Academic test methods and references; obtain actual study before assigning facts.

sources.name: Iowa State agricultural machinery literature
sources.scope: Historic catalogue evidence; item-specific rights.

sources.name: Wageningen Special Collections
sources.scope: Historical brochures/manuals; engineering photo collection has CC BY-NC 4.0, do not reuse commercially without separate permission.

sources.name: McCormick-International Harvester Collection
sources.scope: Production records, catalogues, photos; item-level permission; no presumed open licence.

sources.name: Allison tractor manuals collection
sources.scope: Finding aid; digitization and access not guaranteed.

sources.name: TractorData
sources.scope: Secondary independent discovery and cross-check only; follow primary sources; respect rights, no bulk reproduction.

sources.name: Finna
sources.scope: Search tractor/traktori/Valmet/Valtra and local model names. Metadata CC0 is not image licence. Require item-specific commercial and derivative permission.

sources.name: Smithsonian Open Access
sources.scope: Only item-specific CC0 media; distinguish real full-size tractors from toy/model objects.

sources.name: Library of Congress FSA-OWI
sources.scope: Historical photos; verify rights advisory and original agency/creator, copied images may be restricted.

sources.name: Digital Public Library of America
sources.scope: Aggregator; follow original institution and item rights; no blanket permission.

sources.name: Europeana agricultural machinery
sources.scope: Follow original provider and per-object rights, no aggregator licence assumption.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.scope: Existing Commons provider; file-specific rights, source and visual identity. Respect Retry-After.

sources.name: Openverse
sources.scope: Existing Flickr/Europeana integration, only leads; verify original provider metadata and original file.

sources.name: Flickr
sources.scope: Use only creator-specific permitted works and original rights, never assume all photos reusable.
